name: Password Manager
description: Organize local passwords in nested groups. Vault always AES-GCM encrypted; optional Argon2id master password.
releaseNotes: v0.3.2: Windows atomic replace (MoveFileEx), GCM AAD + Argon2 params in envelope (v3), zeroize keys, envelope validation, list redacts passwords (password/get for detail), i18n/clipboard UX.
